references.text: Contrast in dominion: Oppression (Pharaoh's straw demand) versus merciful leadership (Boaz's permission to glean).
Direct narrative continuity: Ruth's arrival (v.7) and Boaz's protection (v.16).
Thematic parallel: Mercy toward the weak/captive (do not strike down/give food).
Contrast in the grain motif: Destruction of grain piles (judgment) versus preservation for gleaning (provision).
